caseName: Vicksburg Water Works Co. v. Yazoo & Mississippi Valley Railroad
caseNameFull: The Vicksburg Water Works Company, in Error v. Yazoo & Mississippi Valley Railroad Company
disposition: Motion to dismiss or affirm submitted February 27, 1911.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Mississippi..
attorneys: Mr. Charles N. Burch and Mr. Edward Mayes for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Great Western Telegraph Company v. Burnham, 162 U. S. 339; Slosser v. Hemphill, 198 U. S. 173. Mr. J. C. Bryson for the plaintiff in error.
